_about: Equalizer preset sets for Soundcore models, by the name each model's eq.presets uses in devices.json. custom_preset is the preset number of a custom curve (null: the model has none), band_hz the visible bands, hidden_bands the values sent for bands past them with a custom curve, custom_range the slider range of a custom curve, each in the model's own units. Presets carry their number, OpenSCQ30's key, an English name and the curve the app sends.
